$comment: Gzipped bytes the browser downloads. firstView is what the page loads before it shows anything (the entry chunk and the CSS it links), set from a build with about 15% to spare, rounded up to a whole 100 bytes: real headroom, so an ordinary change fits, and raising it is a decision for review, not a fix. What the first view does not draw loads later, with lazy(), and is not in it. total is everything the build makes, lazy chunks included, held loosely, a quarter over the same build, so that a new lazy page fits and only a runaway dependency does not.
